newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares perk up in final hour of trade.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares perk up in final hour of trade.

text.p: 1530 GMT - Italian shares perked up in the last hour of trading, boosted by a strong opening on Wall Street and dollar strength, in line with major stock exchanges throughout Europe.
* The all-share Mibtel index closed 2.24 percent higher at 13,477 with the Mib30 index gaining 2.7 percent. Turnover was slightly lower than on Monday at 1.192 trillion lire.
* Export-oriented clothes makers, including Benetton, Stefanel and Marzotto all closed firmly up, apparently boosted by the U.S. currency's buoyancy.
* Brokers said most of the action was seen in the last hour of trade after the Wall Street opening. The day had got off to a slow start and the flurry of late trading took many operators by surprise.
* Banks were among the star performers, led by Credito Italiano, which finished 6.18 percent higher at 3,299 lire, and BCI, ending the day 5.11 percent up at 3,720 lire.
* Industrials also performed well, Fiat rising 3.08 percent to 6,298 lire, Pirelli up 2.05 percent at 4,373 lire with HPI rising 1.3 percent to 827 lire.

* Telecom stocks were firmer, Telecom Italia Mobile up 2.85 percent at 5,623 lire, Telecom Italia gaining 1.52 percent to 5,538 lire and Stet advancing 1.06 percent to 10,006 lire. Milan newsroom +392-66102321
